map.name: witness-architectures
map.of: Kinds of instrument, setting, arrangement of people, record, or rule that must exist before a real difference can leave a trace at all, including what the witness must be built not to see and when building it makes the fact.
items: Refractory blink: a detector must recover faster than events arrive or two close arrivals fuse into one count, as a Geiger tube's dead time swallows the second of two near-simultaneous decays; not a sensitivity problem, since a loud event vanishes just as completely if it lands inside the recovery.

Enough bodies: a difference in rate leaves no trace in a population too small for the rare case to be expected even once, as a one-in-a-hundred-thousand harm will almost never occur in a trial of three thousand; not instrument sensitivity but the count of chances, so the missing witness is a denominator.

Burial lottery: a soft body leaves a trace only where anoxic mud, rapid burial, and absent scavengers coincide, so the fossil record witnesses depositional regimes before it witnesses animals; an absence in the record is first an absence of the regime, and the witness was built by accident of geography rather than by anyone.

Mine for silence: a faint difference registers only after the dominant signal is removed rather than the faint one amplified, as neutrino detectors sit under a kilometer of rock and stars appear only when the sun is gone; the witness is a subtraction, and no gain in sensitivity reaches below the floor the background sets.

Second ear: a single instrument cannot tell the world from its own twitch, so the record is the coincidence of two detectors far enough apart, or different enough in make, to share no twitch, as the paired gravitational-wave sites are separated by a continent; not replication for confidence, but the only witness to the difference between signal and instrument.

Common meter: two observers can discover that they differ only against a third thing both compare to, a standard bar, a shared clock, a benchmark bolted into bedrock for the next century's surveyor; not a counterpart that differs from the object, but a reference that stays put while the object and the observer both move.

Untouched twin: a difference is recordable only as a difference from something, so a cured patient witnesses nothing until an untreated counterpart exists that differs from her only in the treatment; not more measurement of the treated case, but the manufacture of a second case.

Room for strangers: a pattern spread across separately held private memories becomes recordable only in a setting where strangers can compare them, as eight tenants each know one eviction and none knows a landlord; not a matter of how many memories exist, but of whether the comparison operation has anywhere to happen.

Half kept back: a reading that consumes its specimen leaves no trace of its own error, and none for any question asked afterward, unless a duplicate was reserved before the reading, as radiocarbon dating burns the sample and split-sample rules keep a sealed half; the witness architecture includes one copy to destroy and one to keep, and the reservation must precede the question.

Trigger's blind spot: a recorder flooded past its storage must decide before writing what to keep, so a difference nobody anticipated is discarded before it exists on disk, as a collider's trigger drops nearly every collision by design; not dead time, which is capacity, but selection, and the witness must be told what to expect.

Writable counterexample: a refutation cannot exist until a notation exists in which the offending object can be stated, as a continuous nowhere-differentiable curve could not be set down until functions could be arbitrary rules and limits could be written uniformly; not a proof but a language, and the belief it refuted stood for decades because nothing then writable could contradict it.

Cage for the proof: the difference between not yet proven and unprovable leaves a trace only once the proof system is itself a finite object that can be reasoned about, as the continuum hypothesis became independent rather than merely open; a witness for a negative, and the only kind that can record that a search will never succeed.

Deputized injury: a tribunal registers a harm only when some person entitled to bring it exists, so a poisoned commons injures everyone and therefore no one with standing; not a lack of evidence, since the record may be complete while the court stays deaf until a qualified bearer of the injury speaks.

Arm's-length custody: a fact about an institution registers only if a copy of its record lives beyond the institution's reach, in a notary's book, an escrow, a log written to a server the subject cannot touch; not whether the record exists but who can delete it, and a perfect record in the accused's drawer witnesses nothing.

Silence priced as guilt: when only the party at fault can host the instrument, as with a smokestack monitor, the witness registers only under a rule that scores a gap in the record as the worst possible reading, so that not witnessing costs more than being witnessed; not custody, which is who may delete, but an arrangement that makes the accused build.

The hide: the witness must be concealed from the witnessed for the natural difference to appear, as in a birdwatcher's blind or a one-way mirror, where the watched party behaves as if unwatched; built blindness pointing outward, and the concealed part remains recoverable by someone holding the key.

Blindfolded tally: some aggregate facts register truthfully only through a witness built so that it cannot see the parts, as a secret ballot records the electorate only because no one can record a voter; built blindness pointing inward, and unlike the hide's key and the blinded assessor's sealed envelope there is no key at all, since recoverability would falsify the aggregate.

Ledger that makes the debt: past the level of recording, some differences exist only because their witness exists, as a bank balance without the bank's ledger or a marriage without the registry that defines it is not an unrecorded fact but no fact, so building the witness constitutes what it records; analytical about performative facts, with no claim that physical measurement creates what it measures.

seriation.axis: How far the witness must be shaped against the difference it records: from mere adequacy (it need only keep up, count enough, be quiet enough) through comparison and anticipation, to authority over who may bring, delete, or build, to built blindness, and finally to constitution, where the witness is the fact.
seriation.note: An authored walk, not a scale of sophistication or necessary stages. Refractory blink opens it because a witness there needs no design beyond keeping pace; Ledger that makes the debt closes it because nothing is left for the witness to be adequate to. Blindfolded tally → Ledger that makes the debt is the hinge: once a witness is built so that only the sum can be seen, the sum is the only fact there is, and recording tips into constituting. The hide sits just before it as the last witness that keeps a key. Reordered after independent review: Burial lottery now follows Enough bodies, since both are denominators of chance the witness did not design (a population large enough, a regime that must occur); Writable counterexample and Cage for the proof now follow Trigger's blind spot in the anticipation stage, and the adjacency Trigger's blind spot → Writable counterexample teaches that a trigger discards what it was not told to expect and a notation cannot state what it was not built to express, the same blindness one level up, in the language rather than the buffer.

boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not an empirical taxonomy or a partition; a real case usually needs several of these witnesses at once, and the list makes no claim to cover every kind.
The seriation is an itinerary of how far the witness must be shaped against the difference, not a ranking of difficulty, cost, or historical order; map edges are conditional authored claims.

The illustrative cases (collider trigger, Burgess-type burial, paired interferometers, stack monitoring, secret ballots) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about the specific histories.
Ledger that makes the debt is analytical about performative facts only; whether any physical difference is constituted by its witness is deliberately left outside the list.
Witness-destroying arrangements (censorship, dead-letter drops, records sealed forever) are outside except where destruction doubles as construction, as in the tally.

case_in: An arrangement built so that a quality indicator's definition and its source leave a trace that the filing hospital cannot later alter: the State Health Register under Rule 14, kept by the state, readable by hospitals but not editable or deletable by them, every entry carrying the filing hospital, the date, and the filing officer's name. Alder Regional Hospital's emergency department chose its triage protocol in 2017; the Triage Selection Committee, three clinicians, weighed Protocol Q, a five-level triage, against Protocol P, a two-stream fast-track, and defined one number to decide between them, the 72-hour re-presentation share, patients who return within 72 hours of discharge divided by patients discharged that month, the one outcome on which P and Q were predicted to differ. The committee worked in a hosted project board holding P's proposal, the predictions, and the argument; the board was decommissioned in March 2020 without export, and no copy of P's proposal exists anywhere else. Q was adopted. On 3 November 2017 the quality officer, Rhea Lindqvist, filed the share's definition with the register as the department's quality indicator; the filed definition is, word for word, the text now in the department's dashboard configuration; the filing carries no statement of purpose, and neither the register nor anything at the hospital names Protocol P. The register was built to hold the definition, the hospital, the date, and the officer, and not the purpose. Since January 2018 the hospital has filed the share monthly, and the register publishes only the monthly figure, naming nobody. Because the share is the registered indicator, since January 2018 the department has telephoned every patient counted in it within a week of the return, offered a waiver of the second visit's fee, and asked for a signed release that includes not filing with the State Patient Complaint Docket; a docket hearing is the only setting in which two such patients could learn that they returned for the same cause, since each patient knows only their own return. Between January 2018 and June 2025, 214 releases were signed, no docket complaint concerning a 72-hour return has been filed, and no hearing has convened. No member of the 2017 committee remains, and Lindqvist left in 2019. In August 2025 the current quality manager, Dana Okafor, who joined in 2023, preparing the annual indicator review, reads the definition in the dashboard configuration and in the register, finds them identical and the filing signed by Lindqvist on 3 November 2017, so the definition's source is readable from the arrangement and not inferred, finds nothing at the hospital or in the register saying why this outcome and not another is the indicator, and drafts the review with the share listed as 'legacy indicator, purpose not recorded, recommend retire'.

fence_out.rule: If the case is read as the setting that must be built so strangers can compare private memories, it is here as Room for strangers; read as the preemption that kept that setting from ever forming, it is there as Unassembled witness, the same tenant-class mechanism seen from the other seat.
fence_out.to_of: Ways a represented or prepared-for alternative that does not occur within an episode changes the actual episode through an identifiable carrier, including by preventing a carrier or witness from forming.
